item_description:
Indication "2 (63)" on the cover page.
The title is not legible on the reproduction.
Two miniatures on fol. 1b. On the left, with caption "rgyal sras zhi ba lha la skyabs su mchi'o", and on the right with caption "rgyal sras thogs med °° gsol ba 'debs ||".
Words indicating the beginning of ections (dang po, etc.) appear blurred in the reproduction; they were probably marked in color in the manuscript.
